name: chunk_cumsum
description: Chunked dt/A cumulative sum with signature chunk_cumsum(dt, A, chunk_size, dt_bias=None, dt_softplus=False). dt is [batch, seqlen, nheads], A is [nheads], and dt_bias is optional [nheads]. Add dt_bias if present, apply softplus only where the biased value is <=20 when dt_softplus is true, clamp to >=0, reshape into ceil(seqlen/chunk_size) chunks, multiply by A per head, and cumulatively sum along each chunk. Return newly allocated float32 (dt_out, da_cumsum), each shaped [batch, nheads, nchunks, chunk_size]; positions beyond seqlen in a final partial chunk are zero-filled. Inputs are not modified. The suite exercises bfloat16 dt with float32 A/bias and seqlen an exact multiple of chunk_size, with chunk sizes 8/16/32/256.
